status_summary: Executive Order 14191, signed 2025-01-29, directed Interior to review mechanisms letting families of BIE-eligible students use federal funds for other schooling options, including private, faith-based and charter schools, to submit a plan within 90 days and to report on BIE school performance. A BIE draft implementation plan overview dated 2025-06-30 was put to tribal consultation on 2025-07-14 and 2025-07-15; a 2025-06-25 news report says the plan stopped short of funding private or charter options after tribal objections. BIE's consultation summary report of 2026-01-22 states that ESEA section 1003A direct student services were selected as the mechanism, with nearly 1.3 million dollars reserved, that only BIE-funded schools may apply and private, faith-based and charter schools are not eligible, that an application is ready and technical assistance webinars were held in fall 2025, and that BIE plans expanded tribal education department grants and support for conversions to tribal control; it reports no awards and no student assessment reporting or parent governance changes. No Land Buy-Back reauthorization was found.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14191 signed, with a section directing Interior to plan school-choice mechanisms for BIE-eligible students.
